title: Finance Variance, 3-Way Match & AR Reconciliation Configuration

org_configured.description: True once entity materiality, AP tolerance, and AR escalation policies are configured.

organization_name.description: Tenant legal entity or finance organization name.

materiality_amount_threshold.description: Absolute variance threshold in reporting currency.

hierarchy_tolerance_amount.description: Maximum allowed rounding delta between GL parent summary totals and sum of leaf lines.

price_tolerance_pct.description: AP 3-way match unit price tolerance fraction (e.g., 0.02 = 2%).

price_tolerance_abs.description: Hard dollar cap per invoice line above which AP Manager approval is required regardless of %.

gr_ir_aging_threshold_days.description: Days before open unmatched GR/IR accruals trigger close escalation.

duplicate_date_window_days.description: Date window in days for fuzzy vendor/amount duplicate invoice detection.

ar_escalation_90_plus_threshold.description: 90+ days past due customer balance threshold triggering formal collections escalation.
